sections.content: Summary of affirmative commands across registers: informal (tú) vs. formal (usted / ustedes).

sections.title: Summary Paradigm
rows: ven, di, sal, haz, ten, ve, pon, sé

items.spanish: Tú: Haz la maleta y ven pronto.
items.english: Informal: Pack your bag and come soon.

items.spanish: Usted: Haga la reserva y venga a las diez.
items.english: Formal: Make the reservation and come at ten.
